description: Someone who likes to wake up and start their day early.
translation: Alguien a quien le gusta despertarse y empezar el día temprano.
example: I'm an early bird, so I usually get most of my work done before noon.

description: Someone who prefers staying awake and being active late at night.
translation: Alguien que prefiere quedarse despierto y activo hasta tarde por la noche.
example: I'm a night owl, so I tend to be more productive in the evening.

description: To depend on coffee to have enough energy.
translation: Depender del café para tener suficiente energía.
example: I practically run on coffee when I have a busy week.

description: To manage two or more parts of your life successfully.
translation: Manejar dos o más partes de tu vida con éxito.
example: I'm trying to find a balance between my career and my personal life.

description: To continue doing something without giving up.
example: It's difficult to stick to a routine when my schedule is unpredictable.

description: To develop a regular pattern of doing things.
translation: Desarrollar un patrón regular de hacer las cosas.
example: It took me a few weeks to get into a routine after starting my new job.

description: To have far too much work to deal with.
translation: Tener demasiado trabajo del que ocuparte.
example: I've been snowed under with work lately.

word: TO MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR TIME
pronunciation: tu méik de móust ov iór táim
description: To use your available time effectively.
example: I try to make the most of my mornings because that's when I'm most focused.

description: To gradually relax after being busy or stressed.
translation: Relajarte poco a poco después de estar ocupado o estresado.
example: I usually wind down by reading or listening to music before bed.

word: TO GET INTO THE SWING OF THINGS
pronunciation: tu guet ín-tu de suíng ov zings
description: To become comfortable and active in a new situation or routine.
translation: Sentirte cómodo y activo en una nueva situación o rutina.
example: It took me a few days to get into the swing of things after my vacation.
